title: Assert the full role-by-permission denial matrix
task:
The permission tests assert what each role CAN do. What matters more is what each role cannot do, and that is untested.

Add `test/permission-matrix.test.mjs` that builds the full cross product of every role in `ROLE_PERMISSIONS` with every permission that appears anywhere in it, plus a role that does not exist, and asserts `can()` for every cell. Derive both axes from the exported table so a new role or permission is covered automatically; do not hard-code the lists.

Assert explicitly that the nonexistent role is denied every permission.

The production code is correct and read-only for this task.
